modelCard.subtitle: Reproducible evaluation, calibration diagnostics, and algorithmic fairness audit for rural healthcare screening.
modelCard.intended_sub: Primary users: Rural Accredited Social Health Activists (ASHAs) conducting 5-minute doorstep visits. Secondary: Primary Health Centre (PHC) medical officers.
modelCard.data_sub: Trained with 80/20 stratified split with 3-fold cross-validated Platt probability scaling. Zero leakage of test folds.
modelCard.fairness_sub: Subgroup evaluations across sensitive demographic features to prevent screening disparities.
modelCard.nolab_heading: No-Lab Screening Model (Without Glucose or HbA1c)
modelCard.nolab_sub: Automatically activated when glucometer / HbA1c labs are unavailable. Uses age, BMI, hypertension/BP, heart disease, smoking & gender.

mentalHealth.title: Mental Health Screening
mentalHealth.subtitle: PHQ-9 — Patient Health Questionnaire. Clinically validated depression screening tool. Takes about 2 minutes.
mentalHealth.prompt: Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you been bothered by…
mentalHealth.sev_minimal_advice: Your score suggests minimal depressive symptoms. Continue with healthy lifestyle habits and self-care.
mentalHealth.sev_mild_advice: Mild symptoms detected. Consider speaking to a mental health professional or counsellor for guidance.
mentalHealth.sev_moderate_advice: Moderate depression detected. We strongly recommend consulting a mental health professional. Help is available.
mentalHealth.sev_mod_sev_advice: Your score indicates moderately severe depression. Please reach out to a mental health professional or crisis line immediately.
mentalHealth.sev_severe_advice: URGENT: Severe depression detected. Please contact a crisis helpline or emergency services immediately. You are not alone.
mentalHealth.q1: Little interest or pleasure in doing things?
mentalHealth.q3: Trouble falling or staying asleep, or sleeping too much?
mentalHealth.q4: Feeling tired or having little energy?
mentalHealth.q6: Feeling bad about yourself — or that you are a failure?
mentalHealth.q7: Trouble concentrating on things, such as reading or watching TV?
mentalHealth.q8: Moving or speaking so slowly that other people could have noticed — or the opposite?
mentalHealth.q9: Thoughts that you would be better off dead, or thoughts of hurting yourself?
mentalHealth.icall_desc: Professional counselling from trained psychologists. Mon–Sat 8am–10pm
mentalHealth.online_desc: Certified therapists via primary care mental health referral portals.
mentalHealth.opd_desc: Visit the psychiatry OPD at your nearest government hospital.
mentalHealth.note: Note: This screening is for informational purposes only and not a clinical diagnosis. Always consult a qualified mental health professional.
